run_googletest_output_test: run the googletest output test to verify Google Test text output matches the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a new golden file by running the test with the --gengolden flag on Linux
normalize_test_output: normalize Google Test program output by removing file locations, stack traces, and time info
remove_stack_trace_details: remove stack trace details from Google Test output replacing them with an omitted placeholder
test_GTestOutputTest_class: test the GTestOutputTest class to compare normalized actual output against the golden file
